title: Bot and channel creation panel missing form semantics and Enter key submission
description: The Add bot or channel drawer uses non-form container elements and does not submit on Enter key press in the input field. In addition, toggle buttons and sign out button lack explicit type='button' attributes.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage 2026-09-14 (Chatticus): CONFIRMED live + code.

Live: create panel name field + Enter left the panel open; no bot created; primary button still visible.

Code: create UI is a `div` + `Input` + click `Button`, not a `<form>`, and the name `Input` has no Enter `onKeyDown`. Contrast: message composer uses a form + Enter-to-send.

Fix: wrap create controls in a form with `onSubmit` → `handleCreate`, or add Enter handler on the name field.
